value.rationale: The result converts a newly completed global three-weight construction into a coordinate-resolved structural invariant. It identifies exactly which quadratic sum controls each minimum dual-check multiplicity, proves that the minimum dual supports cannot form even a \(1\)-design, rules out coordinate transitivity, and for \(m\ge9\) shows every coordinate has locality two while availability is necessarily heterogeneous. These are natural repair and symmetry properties not determined by the published global weight enumerator.
